desc:
🎮 The entire Sprunki universe in one game!

✨ Discover all the official skins and unlock exclusive skins available only here.

🥚 New Game Mode: Steal Eggs!
💨 Train your speed on the Treadmills.
🥚 Steal eggs from the bosses and escape before they catch you!
🐣 Bring the eggs back to the lobby and discover what prize you got.
⭐ Collect increasingly rare Sprunkis!
🏆 Unlock new zones, collect Sprunkis, and grow your collection.

👥 Invite Friends Bonus: +20%

🤍 Created by Capybaras to Power
